battle.name: 骨篤祿攻唐之戰
battle.brief: 垂拱二年（682）冬，吐蕃大論骨篤祿趁唐廷更替、邊防空虛，率騎兵越青海攻入湟水、鄯州一線，與唐邊軍在河湟拉鋸；此役是骨篤祿十年西域攻勢的序幕，三年後他率大軍西進，攻陷龜茲、疏勒，逼唐罷安西四鎮。卡面的羅馬標槍不在此戰場，只標示重型投射槍一類：唐蕃雙方倚重的是弓矢、標箭與城頭弩機。

kit.name: 羅馬標槍
kit.history: 半米長的投槍，槍幹中空。捅穿盾之後就折斷，敵人只能帶著半截槍退回掩體。

countries: 交戰的兩方是吐蕃帝國與唐王朝。吐蕃方面，決策核心在贊普論悉諾寧所在的宮帳，軍權由骨篤祿這樣的大論分掌，出征時以大論、行軍大將軍的名號統兵；兵制以「軍」為編制單位、以「部」為基本建制，平時由部落牧民充當兵源，戰時臨時集結為遠征大軍，步、騎、弓手混編，並設專司攻城的攻城部隊。遠征的補給主要靠青海一帶的牧場、隨軍牛馬馱運以及對戰區的徵發，節奏上配合秋季草場轉水草而東進、春季退回牧地的循環。唐方面，尚書省兵部掌軍令，兵部尚書節制邊軍；河湟、河西一線的守軍當時由行軍大總管、兵馬使一類的臨時職銜分道統轄，節度使建制尚未固定；西域最高的軍府是安西都護府，領龜茲、疏勒、于闐、焉耆四鎮，兵源是關中、隴右、河東抽調的府兵與募兵混合，糧秣靠涼、肅、沙、瓜各州的屯田與河西走廊的轉輸。這是一場防務體系對防務體系的碰撞：一方是高原帝國的機動作戰與投射優勢，另一方是定居王朝的城池、屯田與行政動員。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Tibetan Empire and the Tang dynasty. On the Tibetan side the decision-making core was the imperial court around the ruler Tride Tsuktsen, while the actual command of armies was divided among the great ministers, the dharmas, Gar Trinring among them; campaigns were led under the titles of great minister and of field commander. Troops were organised into dmag units built upon stsog regiments; the peacetime base was the herding clans, who supplied the manpower, and in war these were mustered into far-ranging armies of interleaved foot, horse and archers, with specialist siege contingents attached. Supply came chiefly from the pastures of Qinghai, from ox- and horse-borne trains, and from requisitioning in the country raided; the rhythm of campaigning followed the herds, out in autumn when grass and water improved, back to the pastures in spring. On the Tang side the Ministry of War issued the orders and its minister supervised the frontier forces. The garrisons of the Yellow River bend and of Hexi were then under ad hoc titles such as the Grand Commander of Marching Forces and the Military Commissioner for Horse Troops; the permanent system of regional military governorships did not yet exist. The highest military office in the Western Regions was the Protectorate of Anxi, holding the four garrisons of Kucha, Kashgar, Khotan and Karashahr. Manpower mixed government militia drawn from the capital districts, Longyou and Hedong with recruited men, and grain came from the farms of Liang, Su, Shazhou and Guazhou and from transport along the Hexi Corridor. What collided here was two whole systems of defence: the mobile warfare and shooting strength of a plateau empire on one side, and the walled towns, farms and administrative mobilisation of a settled dynasty on the other.
people: 吐蕃方面最關鍵的人物是大論骨篤祿。他出身的說法在後世記錄中並不一致，有說他原是吐谷渾的貴族或漢地之人，幼年被吐蕃俘獲而憑軍功晉升高位，也有記載強調他出自吐蕃本族；可以確定的是，他在贊普論悉諾寧在位期間掌握實際兵權，是692年西征安西的主帥，也是此後十年間對唐邊境用兵的策劃者。贊普論悉諾寧是這一時期吐蕃的統治者，重要決策在御前作出，而大論一職本身具備制度上的份量。唐方面，垂拱年間由武則天臨朝攝政並於690年稱帝，軍國大事由中樞議定，邊將更替頻繁，政策在「先安北」與「先安西」之間反覆。河西一線的宿將中，以行軍大總管裴行儉最知名，他曾平定西域的叛降勢力，並整飭敦煌與河西的屯田；《資治通鑑》在垂拱年間所記的邊軍，多由兵馬使、行軍大總管一類的職銜分道領兵，與吐蕃在湟水、鄯州一線屢次遭遇。朝議方面，內史狄仁傑等人主張慎用兵、固邊防，反映當時對這場邊境消耗的疑慮。前任安西都護劉仁軌在679年曾於疏勒一線擊破圍城的吐蕃兵，是唐方西域作戰經驗的來源之一，也是日後主張重設四鎮時常被援引的先例。
peopleEn: The decisive figure on the Tibetan side was the great minister Gar Trinring. His origin is described inconsistently in the later records: some hold that he was of Yugu-hun noble birth, or even a man from the Chinese lands, taken captive as a boy and raised by his military service, while others place him among the native Tibetan clans. What is certain is that during the reign of the ruler Tride Tsuktsen he held the real command, that he was the commander of the western expedition against Anxi in 692, and that he planned the pressure on the Tang frontier through the decade that followed. Tride Tsuktsen himself was the emperor at the time; the major decisions were taken at the court, and the office of great minister carried an institutional weight of its own. In Tang China Wu Zetian governed as empress regent through the Chonggui years and took the imperial title in 690; state and military affairs were settled in the central secretariat, frontier commanders were replaced often, and policy swung between securing the north and securing the west. Among the veteran commanders of the Hexi line the Grand Commander Pei Xingjian was the best known; he had put down rebellious and surrendered groups in the Western Regions and had tidied the farms at Dunhuang and along Hexi. In the Zizhi Tongjian of the Chonggui years, the frontier troops that met the Tibetans along the Huangshui and around Shanzhou are shown led by men holding the charge of military commissioner or of grand commander, and the encounters with them are recorded again and again. In the council, ministers such as the Vice Chancellor Di Renjie argued for caution and for holding the frontier, which reflects the court's doubts about this war of attrition. Liu Rengui, a former Protector of Anxi, had broken Tibetan besiegers near Kashgar in 679; he remained a reference point for Tang experience in the Western Regions and a precedent often cited when the four garrisons were to be restored.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是羅馬標槍（pilum），公元前一世紀共和末期成型，是羅馬步兵的制式重型投槍：槍頭是尖錐形鐵矛頭，其下接一段約半米長、細而直的鐵條，鐵條下端套入木柄，全槍約兩米。最出名的設計是把鐵條做得很細，命中盾牌後會彎折滯留在盾上，敵兵難以拔出再用，攻勢因此難以被反擊。羅馬人在二十五到三十米的距離上密集投射這類標槍，覆蓋敵陣前緣，再以短劍與長矛的步兵方陣推進。但這件兵器從未出現在唐蕃戰場：它早於本役數百年，羅馬與吐蕃之間從無任何軍事接觸。它在這張卡上的意義是類別上的——標示「套筒式重型投射槍」這一兵器譜系。唐代兵書把「標、槊」列為步卒常備的投射兵器，功用與羅馬標槍同類，在數十步內擲出，纏鬥之前先壓制敵陣前排；但唐軍的標槍是整支木柄加鐵鏃，形制細長，沒有「命中後彎折難以回收」的設計。吐蕃方面以角弓長矢與標箭為主，攻城時大量使用雲梯、巢車、撞車、擲石機一類器械。唐軍的配備以手弩與擘張弩、床弩見長，環首直刀大量自西域輸入並在安西出土；鎧甲以皮甲、札甲為主，兩軍都配皮盾、拒馬與鹿角。馬匹是吐蕃青海牧場的產物，唐朝則自西域買馬。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Roman pilum, a heavy throwing javelin that took shape in the late Republican period of the first century BC and became standard issue for Roman infantry. Its head is a pointed iron cone, below which is set a thin, straight iron shank about half a metre long; the lower end of that shank is socketed into a wooden shaft, giving a total length of roughly two metres. Its most famous design feature is the thinness of the shank: after striking a shield it buckles and lodges there, so that the defender cannot pull it out and reuse it, and the attack cannot be turned back into the throwers. Roman infantry loosed these javelins in dense volleys at twenty-five to thirty metres, blanketing the front of the enemy line before the infantry closed with short swords and long spears. But the weapon never appeared on a Tang-Tibetan battlefield: it predates this war by centuries, and there was never any military contact between Rome and Tibet. Its place on this card is categorical, marking the line of socketed heavy throwing spears. Tang military manuals list the biao and the shuo among the standard missile weapons of the foot soldier, serving the same function as the pilum, thrown within a few dozen paces to crush the front rank before the melee began; but the Tang biao was a slender wooden shaft with an iron head and lacked the pilum's trick of buckling in the shield. The Tibetans relied chiefly on composite bows, long arrows and throwing darts, and used ladders, siege towers, rams and stone-throwers in quantity against fortifications. The Tang fielded crossbows, both the handheld kind and the powerful windlass-drawn siege crossbows, and took ring-pommel straight swords in large numbers from the west, many of them excavated at Anxi. Armour was mainly hide and lamellar, both armies carried hide shields, chevaux-de-frise and antler obstacles, the horses of the Tibetan host came off the Qinghai pastures, and the Tang bought theirs from the Western Regions.
tactics: 吐蕃的攻勢帶有典型的高原季候節奏：秋季水草轉好時由青海出發，倚賴牧場與戰地徵發維持騎兵行動，直撲唐的邊州與屯田點，春季退回牧地過冬。對峙方式是機動作戰與攻城配合：騎兵負責切斷城間道路、逼迫孤立烽燧與邊寨，步兵與器械隊隨後進抵城下，填壕、架梯、撞門，並以擲石機壓制城頭；一旦某城陷落，即以此為基地向下一城推進，切斷綠洲間的交通。唐軍的應對以據城固守為主幹：河湟、河西各州築城置烽燧，形成以敦煌、瓜、肅、甘、涼為骨幹的縱深防禦，弓弩交替射擊，出城反擊則以騎兵集群掩護步兵突擊，試圖焚燒或分割攻城器械。關鍵的弱點在補給：唐從關內運糧至敦煌已逾一千五百公里，再轉往西域又是數千里荒漠，因此遠征必須帶足數月口糧，士氣與馬匹消耗極大，這也是唐廷多次在反攻四鎮與堅守不出之間搖擺的原因。守軍另一種常規做法是封閉城門、街壘拒馬，僅留小股精兵由專門通道出城夜襲，破壞攻城器械與營壘。
tacticsEn: The Tibetan offensive followed the seasonal rhythm of the plateau: it set out from Qinghai in autumn, when grass and water improved, kept the mounted columns going on the pastures and on requisitioning in the country it overran, struck straight at the Tang border prefectures and farm settlements, and withdrew to the pastures to winter in spring. The method combined mobile action with siege: cavalry cut the roads between towns and strangled isolated beacon towers and frontier forts, while infantry and the train of siege engines moved up to the walls, filled the ditches, set ladders, battered the gates and used stone-throwers to sweep the parapets; once a town fell it became the base for the next push along the chain of oases. The Tang answer was built around holding walled towns: in the Yellow River bend and in Hexi each prefecture built walls and beacon stations, creating a deep system anchored on Dunhuang, Guazhou, Suzhou, Ganzhou and Liangzhou, with bows and crossbows firing in alternation, and any sortie into the open covered by masses of horse so as to strike at the siege engines and try to burn or split them. The weak point was supply: carrying grain from the capital districts to Dunhuang alone ran more than fifteen hundred kilometres, and pushing it on into the Western Regions meant thousands of kilometres more across desert, so any expedition had to carry several months of rations, at heavy cost to morale and to the horses. That is why the Tang court wavered between counter-attacking the four garrisons and simply sitting tight. Another standing practice on the defensive side was to close the gates, block the streets with chevaux-de-frise, and keep only small picked bodies of men to slip out by a hidden way at night to raid the engines and the camp.
data: 先看戰場的尺度。龜茲在今新疆庫車一帶，北緯四十一度七分、東經八十二度九分；疏勒在今喀什一帶，北緯三十九度五分、東經七十六度；于闐在今和田一帶，北緯三十七度一度、東經七十九度九分；焉耆在今焉耆盆地，北緯四十二度、東經八十六度。疏勒至于闐約三百公里，龜茲至焉耆約一百三十公里，疏勒至龜茲沿綠洲折行遠超六百公里，實際行軍常在八百公里以上。敦煌在東經九十四度七分、北緯四十度一度，距龜茲直線已逾一千公里；自長安沿河西走廊至敦煌約一千五百公里，唐人因而以「西域去京師萬餘里」形容這段距離。兵員方面，吐蕃每次遠征的規模在史料中多被描述為數萬之眾；唐方守四鎮的兵力是每城數百至數千，依城分守，援軍則需抽調關內與隴右，動輒上萬。攻城歷時通常以月計：692年夏秋之交發動，秋冬之間四鎮相繼失守，唐廷議罷四鎮已到次年春天。數字方面要留意，唐代文獻與敦煌、吐魯番出土的軍糧、屯田文書可以互相印證糧秣的龐雜與消耗，但雙方確切死傷人數沒有可核的記載，本役只宜用「守軍多隨城陷而沒，倖存者散歸或被俘」這樣的概括。
dataEn: Start with the scale of the ground. Kucha lies near present-day Kuqa in southern Xinjiang, at 41.7 degrees north and 82.9 degrees east; Kashgar near 39.5 north and 76.0 east; Khotan near 37.1 north and 79.9 east; Karashahr in the Yanqi basin at about 42 north and 86.2 east. Kashgar to Khotan is roughly three hundred kilometres, Kucha to Karashahr about a hundred and thirty, and the road along the oases from Kashgar to Kucha runs well over six hundred kilometres, in practice more than eight hundred by marching. Dunhuang, at 94.7 east and 40.1 north, already stands more than a thousand kilometres in a straight line from Kucha; from Chang'an along the Hexi Corridor to Dunhuang is about fifteen hundred kilometres, which is why the Tang spoke of the Western Regions as more than ten thousand li from the capital. On troop numbers, Tibetan expeditions of this kind are described in the sources as tens of thousands; the Tang garrisons of the four towns were a few hundred to a few thousand men each, allotted town by town, and reliefs had to be drawn from the capital districts and Longyou, often numbering more than ten thousand. Sieges normally ran for months: the campaign of 692 was launched in high summer, the four garrisons had fallen by late autumn and winter, and the court only debated abandoning them in the spring of the year after. A caution about the numbers: Tang documents and the military and farm records excavated at Dunhuang and Turfan corroborate one another on the bulk and the wastage of grain, but no verifiable casualty returns survive for either side, and the only defensible summary is that most of the garrison died with its walls and that the survivors either scattered or were taken captive.
cause: 打起來的理由有遠近兩層。遠層是吐蕃在高原完成整合後必然向外伸展：贊普論悉諾寧執政，骨篤祿等大論力主西進，把安西四鎮與河湟一線視為可爭之地。貼近的一層是唐朝自身的邊防推進與西域羈縻控制：唐在西域設四鎮、在河湟與河西推進屯田與烽燧，界線越推越近，與吐蕃的牧地及小邦直接相接，衝突便由零星掠奪逐步升級為成建制的進攻。682年前後的時機同樣關鍵：高宗病逝、中宮與武則天共同聽政，朝局更替使邊軍統帥與政策反覆，契丹與突厥問題又把北方兵力和注意力拖住；唐廷以為吐蕃的遠征消耗巨大、難以持久，吐蕃則判定唐無力西顧，於是每年的季節性進攻都變得更具攻擊性。直接引爆的則是邊境上一次次被記錄下來的羊馬之爭：一次雙方都願意容忍的小規模掠奪被回報成入侵，報復再變成掠奪，最終把零星的接觸累積成一支能攻城的遠征大軍。
causeEn: There were a distant and an immediate set of reasons. The distant one is that once the plateau had been consolidated, Tibet necessarily pushed outward: under Tride Tsuktsen the great ministers such as Gar Trinring pressed the campaign west and treated the four garrisons of Anxi and the Yellow River bend as ground to be contested. The immediate one is the Tang advance itself, with its garrison towns and colonies in the Western Regions and its farms and beacon stations pushed forward in the Yellow River bend and in Hexi, so that the frontier ran ever closer to Tibetan pasture and to the smaller states there, and friction over cattle and grazing escalated by degrees into wars of formed divisions. The moment mattered as well: Gaozong had died, the empress and the empress dowager Wu were directing affairs, changes of government brought repeated changes of frontier commanders and of policy, and trouble with the Khitan and the Turks pulled troops and attention northward. The Tang assumed that a Tibetan expedition would exhaust itself before it could reach them, while the Tibetans judged that the Tang could not spare the west, and every seasonal raid accordingly grew bolder. What actually set the spark was the recurrent quarrel over cattle and horses along the border: a small raid that each side was willing to tolerate was reported back as an invasion, the reprisal returned as another raid, and the accumulated contact grew into a field army with the means to take walled towns.
impact: 對唐朝而言，最直接的後果是西域經營中斷。安西四鎮在692年陷落後，安西都護府形同虛設，唐的影響退到玉門關以東，絲路中段落入吐蕃與西域諸小國之手，龜茲、疏勒的漢唐民政與軍事機構停擺；此後數十年，漢地輸往西域的絲織品、鐵器、瓷器與西域輸入的良馬、玉石大幅減少，佛教、曆法、文字在綠洲城邦之間的流動方向也為之改變。對中亞格局而言，唐在安西的支柱被抽走，等於為751年怛羅斯一戰後大食、葛邏祿勢力東進讓出了空間，兩河流域與天山南北的商路重心往南移動。對吐蕃而言，這是一段鼎盛的開始：帝國取得西域霸權，遠征帶來的戰利品與俘獲支撐了高原的消耗，但同時把遠距離補給的弱點暴露無遺，兵源、馬匹與牧地管理都繃到極限。755年天寶之亂後唐廷自顧不暇，吐蕃一度攻入關中、於763年佔領長安，卻在不到一年內自行撤出，正是這種國力透支的結果之一。制度上，這十年逼著唐廷反覆調整邊軍編制、屯田與轉輸體制，也成為日後節度使制度與多路節度並存的背景。
impactEn: The most direct consequence for the Tang was the interruption of its administration of the Western Regions. With the four garrisons of Anxi lost in 692, the Protectorate of Anxi became a name on paper, Tang influence pulled back to the east of the Yumenguan, and the middle stretch of the Silk Road passed into the hands of Tibet and the oasis states. The Han and Tang civil and military institutions of Kucha and Kashgar stopped where they stood, and for the following decades the flow of silk, iron and porcelain westward and of fine horses and jade eastward fell away sharply; even the direction in which Buddhism, calendars and scripts moved among the oasis towns changed. For the shape of Central Asia, the removal of the Tang pillar in Anxi left room for the Arab and Karluk powers to expand eastward after the battle of Talas in 751, and the centre of gravity of the trade routes between Mesopotamia and the Tian Shan shifted south. For Tibet this was the opening of the great age: the empire gained supremacy in the Western Regions, and the plunder and captives of the expedition sustained the plateau, but the same campaign exposed the weakness of long-range supply in stark terms, with manpower, horses and pasture management all strained to the limit. When the Tianbao rebellion broke out in 755 and the Tang could no longer spare men, Tibet pushed into Guanzhong and took Chang'an in 763, yet withdrew again in less than a year, which is one of the clearest results of that over-expenditure. Institutionally, those ten years forced the Tang to recast its frontier commands, its farms and its transport arrangements, and they form part of the background to the later system of regional military governorships and of several great commands existing side by side.
result: 682年這一場本身以唐邊軍在湟水一線的抵禦與反擊收場，交手規模有限，沒有分出勝負，卻是骨篤祿十年攻勢的起點。此後三年形勢急轉：692年他率大軍西進，龜茲、疏勒等城相繼淪陷，唐廷被迫罷安西四鎮、撤安西都護，西域霸權易手，這是骨篤祿本人指揮下最完整的成果。吐蕃雖得手，四鎮之間的道路、餘糧與各城的抵抗能力並未完全掌控，於是雙方進入長拉鋸：唐廷一次又一次從河西出師爭奪，勝敗互見，能守住的往往只是孤立的幾座城；直到開元年間唐廷重建安西都護與四鎮節度使的建制，龜茲、疏勒才逐步回到唐手，750年前後吐蕃再度奪回兩鎮，751年怛羅斯一戰唐軍失利，四鎮再度失去，直到安史之亂後形勢才徹底改觀。骨篤祿在這一輪攻勢的高峰之後淡出史錄中心，戰線由論悉諾寧時代的其他將領接續。結果的總結是短期的得失與長期的消耗：吐蕃得了西域卻透支了國力，唐朝失了西域卻在制度與邊防上被迫重整，兩者都把這十年算作唐蕃百餘年衝突中最長的一段消耗戰。
resultEn: The battle of 682 itself ended with the Tang frontier troops holding the line along the Huangshui and counter-attacking; the engagement was limited and inconclusive, yet it was the opening of Gar Trinring's decade of offensive. Three years later the situation turned quickly: in 692 he led a field army west, Kucha, Kashgar and the other towns fell one after another, the Tang court was forced to abolish the four garrisons and withdraw the Protector of Anxi, and mastery of the Western Regions changed hands. This was the fullest single result won under Gar Trinring's own command. Tibet held the towns, but did not fully control the roads between them, the grain left behind, or the resistance of the garrisons, so a long see-saw followed: the court marched out of Hexi again and again to contest the ground, wins and losses alternated, and what it could hold was usually a few isolated towns. Only in the Kaiyuan years, when the court rebuilt the Protectorate of Anxi and the commands of the four garrisons, did Kucha and Kashgar gradually return to Tang hands, before Tibet took the two towns again around 750 and the defeat at Talas in 751 cost the Tang the garrisons once more, until the whole question changed shape with the An Lushan rebellion. After the high point of that round Gar Trinring faded from the centre of the historical record, and the front was carried on by other commanders of Tride Tsuktsen's reign. The summary of the result is a short-term gain set against a long-term exhaustion: Tibet won the Western Regions and overdrawn its own strength, the Tang lost the Western Regions and was driven to rebuild its frontier institutions and its supply system, and both counted these ten years among the longest attritional campaigns of a century and a half of Tang-Tibetan war.
